title: NLTK: Uncontrolled recursion in CCG lexicon parser causes denial of service via deeply nested category input…
description: NLTK's CCG lexicon parser suffers from uncontrolled recursion when parsing deeply nested parenthesized categories, leading to a denial of service via an unhandled RecursionError. This occurs because the parser functions do not limit recursion depth or input length, allowing crafted inputs to exceed Python's recursion limit and abort parsing. The issue affects versions prior to 3.10.4 and has been fixed in version 3.10.4.
